help.about: Tabletop campaigns with a local Jan model as the game master: a party, a map, dice rolls, and the story kept as you play.

manifest.summary: Tabletop role-playing campaigns with Jan as the game master. Pick a world (sword and sorcery, starship crew, city noir, gothic horror; one JSON file each in worlds/), name the party, and Jan opens the scene. Each player's action goes in the story and Jan answers in character; when an outcome is uncertain it asks for a roll, which shows as a button, and it can hurt or heal the party, which moves their HP bars. Dice (1d20+3, 4d6kh3 and so on) are rolled by the app, never by Jan. Party cards with HP, grid maps with painted ground and draggable tokens that Jan is told about, a running story-so-far that keeps Jan's context small, Ask again, out-of-character notes, and the whole story saved as Markdown. Jan's models load only while it writes and are released when idle (shared/forge_jan.py).
